meanings.en: under a magic spell; enchanted or fascinated
meanings.exampleEn: The audience sat bewitched by the singer's voice.
meanings.exampleTr: Seyirciler şarkıcının sesiyle büyülenmiş halde oturdu.

meanings.en: intolerance toward those who hold different opinions or beliefs
meanings.exampleEn: The organization fights against racism and bigotry.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuruluş ırkçılık ve bağnazlığa karşı mücadele ediyor.

meanings.en: a public notice that a baby has been born
meanings.exampleEn: They sent out a birth announcement with their newborn's photo.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni doğan bebeklerinin fotoğrafıyla bir doğum ilanı gönderdiler.

meanings.en: anger and unhappiness caused by feeling treated unfairly
meanings.exampleEn: She spoke with bitterness about being passed over for promotion.
meanings.exampleTr: Terfi için atlanması konusunda hınçla konuştu.

meanings.en: a sharp, unpleasant taste
meanings.exampleEn: The bitterness of the coffee made her wince.
meanings.exampleTr: Kahvenin acılığı yüzünü buruşturdu.

meanings.en: a period when there is no electricity in an area
meanings.exampleEn: The storm caused a blackout across the whole city.
meanings.exampleTr: Fırtına tüm şehirde bir elektrik kesintisine yol açtı.

meanings.en: a temporary loss of consciousness or memory
meanings.exampleEn: He suffered a blackout and collapsed on the floor.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir bayılma geçirdi ve yere yığıldı.

meanings.en: the quality of being dull, uninteresting, or without strong flavour
meanings.exampleEn: Critics complained about the blandness of the new menu.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştirmenler yeni menünün tatsızlığından şikayet etti.

meanings.en: showing disrespect toward God or sacred things
meanings.exampleEn: The book was banned for its blasphemous content.
meanings.exampleTr: Kitap, kutsala saygısız içeriği nedeniyle yasaklandı.

meanings.en: extremely hot
meanings.exampleEn: They played in the blistering heat of the afternoon.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğleden sonranın kavurucu sıcağında oynadılar.

meanings.en: very forceful or severe in criticism
meanings.exampleEn: The report was a blistering attack on the government.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor, hükümete yönelik sert bir saldırıydı.

meanings.en: swollen with liquid or gas
meanings.exampleEn: After the huge meal he felt bloated and tired.
meanings.exampleTr: Kocaman yemekten sonra kendini şişkin ve yorgun hissetti.

meanings.en: larger than needed; excessively big
meanings.exampleEn: The company was criticized for its bloated management structure.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket, hantal yönetim yapısı nedeniyle eleştirildi.

meanings.en: something that prevents progress or stops something happening
meanings.exampleEn: The missing approval is the main blocker for the project.
meanings.exampleTr: Eksik onay, proje için ana engel durumunda.

meanings.en: the killing or wounding of people, usually in fighting
meanings.exampleEn: The peace talks aimed to end the bloodshed.
meanings.exampleTr: Barış görüşmeleri kan dökülmesini sona erdirmeyi amaçlıyordu.

meanings.en: a detailed plan for achieving something
meanings.exampleEn: The report offers a blueprint for economic reform.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor, ekonomik reform için bir ana plan sunuyor.

meanings.en: a technical drawing of a building or machine
meanings.exampleEn: The architect showed us the blueprint of the new office.
meanings.exampleTr: Mimar bize yeni ofisin teknik çizimini gösterdi.

meanings.en: not clear or sharp in outline
meanings.exampleEn: The photo was too blurry to see anyone's face.
meanings.exampleTr: Fotoğraf, kimsenin yüzünü görmeye çok bulanıktı.

meanings.en: to say something suddenly without thinking
meanings.exampleEn: She blurted out the secret before she could stop herself.
meanings.exampleTr: Kendini durduramadan sırrı ağzından kaçırdı.

meanings.en: with strong, gusty winds
meanings.exampleEn: It was a cold, blustery day on the coast.
meanings.exampleTr: Sahilde soğuk, rüzgarlı bir gündü.

meanings.en: a group of people who manage a company or organization
meanings.exampleEn: The board approved the merger unanimously.
meanings.exampleTr: Yönetim kurulu birleşmeyi oybirliğiyle onayladı.

meanings.en: a flat piece of wood or other material used for a purpose
meanings.exampleEn: He wrote the results on the board.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonuçları tahtaya yazdı.

meanings.en: a small cylinder holding thread or wire, especially in a machine
meanings.exampleEn: The sewing machine stopped when the bobbin ran out of thread.
meanings.exampleTr: Masuradaki iplik bitince dikiş makinesi durdu.

meanings.en: an area of soft, wet, muddy ground
meanings.exampleEn: The hikers got stuck in a peat bog.
meanings.exampleTr: Yürüyüşçüler bir turba bataklığında sıkışıp kaldı.

meanings.en: something helpful that brings a benefit or advantage
meanings.exampleEn: The new bridge has been a boon to local businesses.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni köprü yerel işletmeler için bir nimet oldu.

meanings.en: valuable things stolen or taken in war
meanings.exampleEn: The pirates divided the booty among the crew.
meanings.exampleTr: Korsanlar ganimeti mürettebat arasında paylaştı.

meanings.en: a scientist who studies plants
meanings.exampleEn: The botanist discovered a rare orchid in the rainforest.
meanings.exampleTr: Botanikçi yağmur ormanında nadir bir orkide keşfetti.

meanings.en: to keep feelings hidden instead of expressing them
meanings.exampleEn: Don't bottle up your anger; talk about it.
meanings.exampleTr: Öfkeni içine atma; onun hakkında konuş.

meanings.en: drinking water sold in sealed plastic or glass bottles
meanings.exampleEn: They bought several cases of bottled water for the trip.
meanings.exampleTr: Gezi için birkaç koli şişe suyu aldılar.

meanings.en: lowest; furthest down
meanings.exampleEn: The keys were in the bottommost drawer.
meanings.exampleTr: Anahtarlar en alttaki çekmecedeydi.

meanings.en: the quality of having no limits or end
meanings.exampleEn: The poem celebrates the boundlessness of the ocean.
meanings.exampleTr: Şiir, okyanusun sınırsızlığını yüceltiyor.

meanings.en: a refusal to buy, use, or take part in something as a protest
meanings.exampleEn: Consumers organized a boycott of the company's products.
meanings.exampleTr: Tüketiciler şirketin ürünlerine karşı bir boykot düzenledi.

meanings.en: to refuse to buy or take part in something as a protest
meanings.exampleEn: Activists urged people to boycott the brand.
meanings.exampleTr: Aktivistler insanları markayı boykot etmeye çağırdı.

meanings.en: talking too proudly about what you have or can do
meanings.exampleEn: Nobody liked his constant bragging about his salary.
meanings.exampleTr: Maaşıyla ilgili sürekli övünmesinden kimse hoşlanmıyordu.

meanings.en: bold and without shame
meanings.exampleEn: It was a brazen lie told right to my face.
meanings.exampleTr: Yüzüme karşı söylenmiş arsız bir yalandı.

meanings.en: in a bold way that shows no shame
meanings.exampleEn: He brazenly ignored the rules in front of everyone.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkesin önünde kuralları pervasızca görmezden geldi.

meanings.en: to stop working (of a machine or vehicle)
meanings.exampleEn: Our car broke down on the motorway.
meanings.exampleTr: Arabamız otoyolda bozuldu.

meanings.en: to fail or collapse (of talks, systems, relationships)
meanings.exampleEn: The negotiations broke down after two days.
meanings.exampleTr: Müzakereler iki gün sonra çöktü.

meanings.en: to divide something into smaller parts to analyse it
meanings.exampleEn: Let me break down the costs for you.
meanings.exampleTr: Maliyetleri sizin için ayrıntılara ayırayım.

meanings.en: the bricks in a wall or building
meanings.exampleEn: The old brickwork needs to be repaired.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski tuğla örgünün onarılması gerekiyor.

meanings.en: to be so full that the contents spill over the edge
meanings.exampleEn: Her eyes brimmed over with tears of joy.
meanings.exampleTr: Gözleri sevinç gözyaşlarıyla dolup taştı.

meanings.tr: eşik, kıyı, sınır (bir durumun başlangıç noktası)
meanings.en: the point just before a situation, often a bad one, begins
meanings.exampleEn: The company was on the brink of bankruptcy.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket iflasın eşiğindeydi.

meanings.en: quick and energetic
meanings.exampleEn: They went for a brisk walk before breakfast.
meanings.exampleTr: Kahvaltıdan önce hızlı bir yürüyüşe çıktılar.

meanings.en: busy, with a lot of activity or sales
meanings.exampleEn: Business was brisk during the holiday season.
meanings.exampleTr: Tatil sezonunda işler hareketliydi.

meanings.en: hard but easily broken
meanings.exampleEn: The old paper had become dry and brittle.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski kağıt kuru ve kırılgan hale gelmişti.

meanings.en: caused to fall, fail, or be reduced
meanings.exampleEn: The scandal brought down the entire government.
meanings.exampleTr: Skandal, tüm hükümeti devirdi.

meanings.en: to treat someone in a cruel, violent way
meanings.exampleEn: The prisoners were brutalized by their guards.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkumlar gardiyanları tarafından vahşice muamele gördü.

meanings.tr: genel eğilime ters gitmek, akıntıya karşı kürek çekmek
meanings.en: to do the opposite of what most others are doing
meanings.exampleEn: Their sales rose sharply, bucking the trend of a weak market.
meanings.exampleTr: Satışları keskin biçimde arttı ve zayıf piyasa eğilimine ters gitti.

meanings.en: to fasten something with a buckle
meanings.exampleEn: Please buckle your seatbelt before takeoff.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen kalkıştan önce emniyet kemerinizi bağlayın.

meanings.en: to bend or collapse under pressure or weight
meanings.exampleEn: His knees began to buckle under the heavy load.
meanings.exampleTr: Ağır yük altında dizleri bükülmeye başladı.

meanings.en: the amount by which government or company income exceeds its spending
meanings.exampleEn: The country recorded a budget surplus for the first time in years.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülke yıllar sonra ilk kez bir bütçe fazlası kaydetti.

meanings.en: large and awkward to carry or store
meanings.exampleEn: The parcel was too bulky to fit in the mailbox.
meanings.exampleTr: Paket posta kutusuna sığmayacak kadar hantaldı.

meanings.en: to do something badly or carelessly
meanings.exampleEn: The police were accused of bungling the investigation.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis, soruşturmayı yüzüne gözüne bulaştırmakla suçlandı.

meanings.tr: toptan satın almak, tümünü satın almak
meanings.en: to buy all or as much as possible of something
meanings.exampleEn: Investors rushed to buy up shares before the price rose.
meanings.exampleTr: Yatırımcılar fiyat yükselmeden hisseleri toptan satın almak için akın etti.

meanings.tr: satın alma, şirketi tümüyle satın alma
meanings.en: the purchase of a company or a controlling share in it
meanings.exampleEn: The management arranged a buyout of the struggling firm.
meanings.exampleTr: Yönetim, zor durumdaki firmanın satın alınmasını ayarladı.

meanings.en: done or made by a person rather than a machine
meanings.exampleEn: Each rug is woven by hand.
meanings.exampleTr: Her halı elle dokunuyor.
